topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The rain's a steady drum on the pavement, matching the beat of my feet as I head to the airport. Another case, another mark in the win column. Some kid, middle of nowhere, stuck in this concrete jungle because the sky gods decided to mess with his schedule. Missed his flight, and with it, some big-wig event that meant more than just a guest list. Got a call from him, voice shaking, the kind of scared that money can't fix. But I knew a guy who knew a guy, worked a few angles. Next thing you know, he's on the next flight out, ticker only a bit heavier. Couldn't shake the kid's gratitude. Guess some folks still believe in a little magic. I just call it the city's hidden currents. Now, he owes me one, and I sleep a little better knowing I earned my place in the shadows.
